Title: Assoc Mgr Customer Service (CPFR Latam)

Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more. Required capabilities: Strong business acumen; knowledge of supply chain concepts and retail partner systems; advanced Excel and Power BI analytical skills; ability to build relationships across organizational levels and with customers; Spanish required; availability to travel.
